defects.summary: aiprompt has a text handle but edgePayloadType and drag-to-empty connect offers do not recognize it; a wire can also exist before a drafted output exists.
Reference handles and validator limits are based on image/video mode (14/2), not the selected model's role and cardinality, so visually valid edges can be dropped, truncated, or rejected.
A video media source is accepted by every video generate node, but non-reference models omit videoUrls; the direct media uploader also accepts image/* only despite rendering video.
A generate:video source is accepted before resultKind exists, then resolveRefs unconditionally puts its returned MP4 URL into imageUrls.
Reference-slot identity is compacted during assembly: a lone images[1] edge becomes array index 0 and is serialized as first_frame rather than last_frame.
Changing the selected model neither previews affected inputs nor revalidates/removes incompatible stored edges.
Any wired cast on a video node silently replaces the selected model with the cheapest reference variant after displayed cost and Run-All preview are calculated.

Board image aspect and 1K/2K/4K quality controls do not match active adapter contracts: OpenRouter drops both, Nano Banana reads neither Board key correctly, and GPT Image receives untransformed enums.
The 1..4 tries control is visible on video nodes, but count is omitted from the request, cost, and provider job.
The audio switch is visible for every video model; unsupported OpenRouter models omit it and Gemini Omni adapters ignore it.
Boards has no seed, negative-prompt, or audio-reference data/controls even though model metadata and some adapters expose those capabilities.
Board documents and node data are unversioned, opaque JSON at the API boundary with no runtime node/edge/settings schema or migration contract.
The prompt port is marked required while reference-only execution is allowed; empty prompt/media/aiprompt sources can remain wired and contribute nothing.
Boards lists every active model for every user and defers tier rejection until the credit-spending submit call.
Generate-to-generate cycles are accepted; Run-All appends cyclic nodes and resolveRefs can recursively execute the same cycle.
Board gateway policy says motion refs require AtlasCloud, while current OpenRouter supports typed refs and API model gateway metadata can override the explicit provider selection.
Connection validation is embedded in GraphBoard and lacks a generated per-model contract suite; browser tests prove broad modes rather than every active model/control/input combination.
A location cast with a motion reference is legal on generate:image, where videoUrl is assembled and then discarded.
GPT Image 2 primary routing ignores Board references and n while the API bills n; its fallback chooses a different edit mode.
POST /v1/jobs and /estimate accept generic params and do not share a model-capability normalization schema, allowing quote/delivery and Board/adapter divergence.
